## Current OCR to DeepSeek Rule

DeepSeek is a text lane. Images must be converted into text before DeepSeek sees the article package:

```text
asset extraction / GIF static frame
  -> language-routed OCR
  -> poster_ocr.json
  -> source_evidence/*.source_evidence.md / llm_input.md "## Poster OCR"
  -> DeepSeek text extraction
```

Weekly mini-program public gate, implemented 2026-05-18 09:05:

- `enrich_weekly_activity_pack_with_poster_ocr.py` records `image_id`, image hash/path/source/order/size, heuristic OCR confidence, `text_blocks`, and `line_order` for each OCRed poster/body image.
- `source_evidence_path` points to a unified Markdown evidence package with WeChat text plus Poster OCR sections.
- `enrich_weekly_activity_pack_with_deepseek.py` appends that file into the prompt as `## Unified Source Evidence`.
- DeepSeek may return `field_evidence_refs` for audit; refs are sanitized and kept as metadata, but still cannot bypass deterministic validators.
- Image-heavy short-body rows, aggregate-like rows, and poster-heavy rows require OCR before LLM. If OCR is missing/empty/low-confidence, the row is marked `needs_ocr_review=true`, `publish_blocked=true`, `ocr_preflight_status=needs_ocr_review`.
- `build_weekly_activity_miniprogram_api.py` filters `needs_ocr_review` independently and reports `filtered_counts.needs_ocr_review`.

Public safety rule: MarkItDown is text normalization, not the only fact source; DeepSeek may extract only evidence-backed fields; no source date/no activity date blocks publish; uncertain lineup stays empty; bio and default address/time guesses are forbidden.

## Current Weekly Aggregate Pattern Rule

As of 2026-05-18 22:26 CST, weekly/monthly aggregate handling must be history-pattern based, not keyword guessing:

- Do not classify from `5月` or `本周` alone.
- True aggregate titles need explicit listing language such as `本周活动安排`, `本周活动预览`, `本周信号`, `本周活动一览`, `五月活动`, `五月信号`, `五月一览`, `五月总览`, `五月预览`, `May at ...`, or `Events in May`.
- Date-range listing titles such as `wigwam 活动安排｜05.11-05.25` are aggregate parents even without a `本周/五月` prefix. A parent range is skippable only when its end date is before the display-window start; partial overlap must be expanded and then routed by each child event date.
- Block single-event/detail/non-public-listing cues before Pro extraction: `今晚`, `今日`, `本周六`, `周三`, `@`, `w/`, `with`, `pres.`, `presents`, `呈现`, `专场`, `派对`, `开放日`, `测试开放`, `放映`, `课程`, `DJ课`, `课指南`, `线上电台节目单`, `byyb.radio`.
- If an aggregate title has a date range and the range ends before the display window, archive/review it and do not send it to DeepSeek Pro.
- Reuse DeepSeek child extraction cache keyed by `source_url + article_text_sha256 + model + window`; a changed article body naturally invalidates the cache.
- Repair/audit must check all title variants (`title_display`, `title`, `title_original`, `raw_titles`) so a date-only display title cannot hide an aggregate source title.

## Current Weekly Bio Lineup Rule

As of 2026-05-18 22:46 CST, artist bio-like text may confirm lineup only when the current event evidence also supports the name. It is not a free guessing source.

- Allow source/OCR/evidence lines with event cues such as `w/`, `with`, `pres.`, `presents`, `邀请`, `助力`, `联手`, `奉上`, `专场`, `巡演...站`, or `DJ台交给`.
- Reject bio false friends such as past co-performers, historical festival appearances, representative works, playback counts, education/course text, resident/label biography, and generic profile prose.
- Reject standalone labels and genre/culture terms such as `LINE UP` and `Budots`.
- Slash-joined OCR lineup values can be split only after cleanup and source-context support; malformed live suffixes such as `Aw Live` are removed.

## Current Vector Model Scoring Rule

Vector model choice is a tiered evaluation problem, not a single global leaderboard:

```text
language / script
  -> field path and artifact type
  -> corpus slice and source quality
  -> query type and downstream retrieval/extraction task
  -> model score and promotion gate
```

Current implementation evidence:

- All `scripts/...` paths below are relative to `C:\code\githubstar\wechathtmldownload\tools\stage7_rewrite` (i.e. run from that directory). If running from repo root, prefix with `tools/stage7_rewrite/`.
- `scripts/build_language_field_vector_jobs.py` tags each vector job with `lang`, `field_path`, `model_role`, `channel`, `model`, `dim`, and `routing_reason`.
- `scripts/evaluate_embedding_model_matrix.py` reports `overall`, `by_quality`, `by_type`, and `by_language` metrics using Recall@1/5/10 and MRR@10.
- `scripts/run_vector_collection_router_smoke.py` routes zh/en/mixed cases across Qwen3 current, Snowflake staging, and English sidecar staging collections.

Promotion rule: do not promote a vector model only because its overall score wins. Read language slices, field/type slices, noisy OCR/poster slices, and serving-router evidence together. Keep model, dimension, route role, and source metadata visible even when dimensions match.

## Current Network Entity Evidence Rule

The 2026-05-17 external network research is now part of the **中国地下电子音乐图鉴** pipeline only as report-only evidence.

Allowed roles:

- HTTP fast evidence: first-pass URL metadata, canonical URL, Open Graph, JSON-LD, links, and image candidates.
- OpenCLI: bounded public search and selected read-only adapters.
- Maigret: public handle/profile candidate discovery only.
- Camofox: browser fallback for JS-rendered, anti-bot, or user-authorized public pages.

Hard boundaries:

- Do not use OpenCLI as a 93k/47k full-corpus crawler.
- Do not use Maigret positives as `HAS_PROFILE` proof.
- Do not use Camofox to collect private content or export cookies/tokens.
- Do not write Neo4j production labels, Qdrant production aliases, CloudBase, mem0, production SQLite, or `D:\DJ_DATA` from this gate.
- All network evidence must normalize into JSONL and review queue before any graph candidate pack.

Canonical output shape:

```text
reports/entity_network_YYYYMMDD/seeds.jsonl
reports/entity_network_YYYYMMDD/http_fast_evidence.jsonl
reports/entity_network_YYYYMMDD/opencli_search_results.jsonl
reports/entity_network_YYYYMMDD/maigret_profile_candidates.ndjson
reports/entity_network_YYYYMMDD/camofox_browser_evidence.jsonl
reports/entity_network_YYYYMMDD/normalized_evidence.jsonl
reports/entity_network_YYYYMMDD/review_queue.jsonl
reports/entity_network_YYYYMMDD/summary.md
```

Admission path:

```text
normalized network evidence
  -> manual/direct-source review
  -> GraphCandidatePack
  -> ignuke dry-run
  -> reviewed admission
```

Search-result-only, Maigret-only, and browser-rendered-only records cannot create production graph relationships by themselves.

## Current Weekly Mini-Program DeepSeek Rule

The weekly activity mini-program lane now has a production-facing online DeepSeek enrichment/adjudication entry:

```text
tools/stage7_rewrite/scripts/enrich_weekly_activity_pack_with_deepseek.py
```

Rules:

- Broad/default pack enrichment uses `deepseek-v4-flash`.
- Risk/adjudication rows use `deepseek-v4-pro`.
- Both lanes must keep `thinking={"type":"disabled"}` and `response_format={"type":"json_object"}`.
- The script may clean display/title/style/lineup fields, but final merge remains source-grounded: unsupported time, address, lineup, DJ bio, venue bio, distance, and marketing prose are not accepted.
- Public mini-program entity accuracy is stricter than the internal WeChat download pipeline: candidate fields are not evidence. Keep lineup/address/time only when title, body text, OCR, or child article source explicitly supports them; otherwise clear the field and route users to the source article.
- Candidate fields from source packs, downloaded rows, or model outputs still do not count as evidence by themselves. Lineup must be visible in title, event evidence, description context, OCR, or child article text.
- If `source_evidence_path` exists, DeepSeek must see it as `## Unified Source Evidence`; this is now the preferred input over raw markdown-only article text for poster/image-heavy rows.
- Rows with `needs_ocr_review=true` are not publishable even if they already contain city/address/time candidate fields.
- Curated venue registry addresses are allowed only when no explicit source conflict exists. If source text contains a compatible concrete address, source text wins over stale registry; long prose and bio-like text must never become address.
- Aggregation extraction still belongs in `expand_weekly_aggregate_articles.py`: parent aggregation rows are blocked, child/secondary links are downloaded, in-window child events can publish, and future child events are cached.
- OpenAI OAuth can be used as an optional Codex-side research/comparison/adjudication route through `codex exec` while the CLI is logged in with ChatGPT. It is not a reusable Python API credential for the production pipeline.
- Latest OAuth evidence: `reports/openai_oauth_entity_tests_20260518/`; full current-release source-pack adjudication returned `ok=24`, `needs_fix=0`, `must_fix_ids=[]` after clearing candidate-only lineup and allowing source-text address override.

## Current Weekly Mini-Program Judge Strategy

Implemented locally on 2026-05-18 08:03:

- DeepSeek Flash is the full first-pass model for every row.
- DeepSeek Pro with `thinking={"type":"disabled"}` is a second-pass adjudicator only for explicit risk rows:
  - aggregate child/body rows
  - image-heavy weak-text rows
  - date conflicts
  - lineup weak-evidence rows
  - venue/address conflicts
- Generic review status alone does not justify a Pro call. Publication is decided by deterministic gates, not model confidence.
- Final validator blocks published payloads without source date evidence: `event_date_text` must be a non-empty source-backed array, and `event_date_iso_guesses` must include `event_date_start`.
- Lineup remains optional. If the source text/OCR/title/child article does not support a lineup value, clear it and let the mini-program show source-article guidance instead of guessing.
